notes: Discovery: 196 P2 Grata uids searched in 5 batches of <=40 via search_conferences participant_company_uids; batches returned 58, 4, 20, 52 and 197 events respectively (union taken).
Batch 5 pagination stopped after page 6 of 8: pages 7-8 held only pre-2021 editions of series already captured (wind/water/POWERGEN/rail); truncation accepted to preserve call budget.

search_conferences page displays were context-capped by the MCP layer (e.g. 'Showing 19 of 58'), so a few rows per page were elided by the server; discovered-event union is therefore near-complete but not guaranteed complete.

Keyword discovery call with industries=['Electrical Contractors and Other Wiring Installation Contractors'] returned 0 events (industry facet matches event NAICS classification, which is coarse level-2); no extra call spent retrying.

get_companies_in_list: 40 calls total (37 successful pages at page_size=100, 1 rejected page_size=500 validation error, 2 HTTP-403s on IEEE PES T&D pages 11-12 - deep pages beyond ~page 10 appear blocked). Free per Grata pricing.

IEEE PES T&D 2024 attendees truncated (200/1155, pages 1-2; list is sorted large-company-first, so missing rows skew toward smaller firms - i.e. the P2 intersection for this event is likely UNDERSTATED). POWERGEN 2024 truncated (100/595, page 1). All other kept events fetched in full.

On-thesis events NOT fetched under budget are listed in discarded_events with explicit reasons (facilities shows, NFPA, data center events, renewables family, older editions) - they are candidates for a follow-up pass, not DQs.
Attendee lists are Grata event rosters (exhibitors/participants); intersections use normalized domains (strip protocol/www, lowercase).
Wave-2/3 P2s without Grata uids (338 of 534) could not seed discovery; their conferences surface only via attendee intersection.

Conference attendance is a soft signal: EASA/PEARL attendance corroborates S7/apparatus classification; NECA attendance corroborates T1/T5; per sourcing rule 1, bucket assignment must still come from the company's own description.
